task.title: Disentitlement terminated — Part-time employment on a renewal claim

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign a registration number as follows:
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Work Type: Select 15 - Manual Action code 11, 12 or 14 .
Remarks line 1: Type “labour dispute — entitled to benefits.”
Remarks line 2: Type “D5 to be terminated as of [date].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and save the A-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Disentitlement terminated and/or removed (2591): Select Disentitlement terminated-benefits payable .
Right to Request a Reconsideration (with Blank option) (4169) .

step.cmd: In NWS, create a client Note and type “Send the saved ACS letter.”
Determine if there is an outstanding COR Manual Decision WI:
Determine if there is a system-generated ROD with a negative decision:
Create a COR WI as follows:

ul.li: Claim type: Select the appropriate option.
Destination: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS.
End User: Select Next available user .
Details: Type “A-01-00-01 letter required — labour dispute issue.”

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the ADJ WI for the labour dispute issue.
